title: Our Symbol
slide_intent: Teach the reader to see two meanings in one silhouette: adding an item and enjoying food.
strategic_value: The downward arrow can refer to the shopping action while the root retains the identity’s association with produce.
demonstration: Two captions point to a large green arrow above an orange semicircle. A baseline lets the root appear to emerge from the ground or a cart.
practical_value: Decide how to explain the symbol to a new reader using its two visible components.

content_islands.name: Symbol description
content_islands.spec: Place the descriptive note in a narrow column on the left.

content_islands.name: Labeled carrot
content_islands.spec: Enlarge the mark to the right. Align Shop with its green top and Savor with the orange root; extend a horizontal line beneath the root.
